title: Joining Finch Circle — Enrollment Age, Required Profile Details and Enrollment Bonus
content:
Enrollment terms of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, by tier. The enrollment bonus exists only at the entry tier, Finch Circle Member; the age and profile requirements are the same at every tier.

| Tier | Enrollment bonus (points) | Minimum age to enroll (whole years) | Profile identifiers required to enroll |
|---|---|---|---|
| Finch Circle Member | 500 | 13 | phone number, email |
| Finch Circle Silver | not applicable | 13 | phone number, email |
| Finch Circle Gold | not applicable | 13 | phone number, email |
| Finch Circle Platinum | not applicable | 13 | phone number, email |
| Finch Circle Diamond | not applicable | 13 | phone number, email |
| Finch Circle Icon | not applicable | 13 | phone number, email |

## Definitions

- **Enrollment bonus** — points posted once at enrollment, a whole number.
- **Minimum age** — the minimum age to enroll, in whole years.
- **Required identifiers** — the profile identifiers required to enroll: the phone number and the email on the customer profile.

## Examples (hypothetical)

- An applicant who is 12 years old does not meet the minimum age of 13; at 13 the age term is met.
- A profile with an email but no phone number does not carry every required identifier.
